manifest.name: dsh-opening-animation
manifest.description: Opening animation overlay for DeepSeek Harness Web: user-picked image animations or a video, then a configurable transition hands the screen back to the UI.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

readme.text:
[English](README.en.md)

DeepSeek Harness Web 的开场动画插件：每次 dsh web 页面加载时，在全屏遮罩上播放你选择的开场内容——图片动画或视频——结束后以可配置的过渡效果把画面交还主界面。完美兼容 [dsh-custom-skin](https://github.com/SLin-code/dsh-custom-skin)

- **图片开场**（jpg/png/webp/gif/avif，≤20 MB，导入时实测解码并拒绝超过 3200 万像素（约 8K 幅面）的图片，库上限 8 条；容量截断与解码失败都会明确提示，不会静默丢弃）
- **图片开场播放顺序**（单一/顺序/随机，默认单一）：决定每次启动播放哪张图片开场——顺序从选中项开始，每次启动按图片列表推进、到末尾回绕；随机在多于一张时绝不重复上一张；预览始终播放选中媒体，视频不受此项影响
- **视频开场**（mp4/webm/mkv，≤256 MB，导入时探测解码支持）：自动播放时引擎在首个 playing 事件一律尝试取消静音——浏览器允许有声自动播放时（用户手势、站点媒体参与度达标或站点在浏览器声音允许列表中）按音量设置出声；浏览器拒绝时自动回退为静音播放，画面不会因此卡住，回退为静音时开场画面会出现『点击开启声音』提示，点击即可解除静音（该点击不会跳过动画），播完收场，长视频不截断；选用毛玻璃擦除过渡时，过渡会在视频剩余时长进入其擦除窗口（约 2.4 秒）时提前开始——玻璃蒙上与擦除期间视频继续播放，擦除完成时视频恰好定格在最后一帧（尾帧对齐）；填充方式（铺满 cover / 完整显示 contain，默认 cover）与缩放、水平/垂直偏移可调（缩放默认 1 不缩放，水平/垂直偏移默认 0 居中，单位为屏幕宽/高的百分比）；视频结尾音频按指数曲线淡出（先快后慢），淡出时长可调（默认 1.5 秒，0 为禁用）；视频开头音频按恒定增益（线性）淡入，时长可调（默认 1 秒，0 为禁用），点按『点击开启声音』解除静音时同样淡入
- **收场过渡**：cross-fade（默认）/ dip-to-bg / zoom-fade / glass-wipe，速度可调（0.5–2×）；动画期间主界面被遮罩按住（`#root` 由 pending 属性压住不闪帧），过渡结束后还原。glass-wipe（毛玻璃擦除）分三段：玻璃模糊直接施加在仍在播放的开场动画上（磨砂层以 backdrop-filter 逐级加深，模糊期间开场动画继续播放），模糊加深完毕后一支宽毛刷以三道折返笔触扫过毛玻璃（程序生成的毛刷印记，边缘带纤维质感；被擦除的清晰区域展示壁纸（安装并启用了 [dsh-custom-skin](https://github.com/SLin-code/dsh-custom-skin) 时取其当前激活壁纸、并遵循其填充与位置设置；未装、未启用或读取失败时展示当前开场素材，视频素材以静音自动播放呈现），笔触扫完后若有未擦除的角落，擦除区域直接从笔刷末点扩散至全屏；最后整个遮罩层与已淡入的主界面交叉淡出、立即交还组件（开场内容的尾帧不会单独闪现）。过渡时长计入图片开场的时长上限（见下条保险），过渡播完即收尾，不额外占用屏幕。壁纸读取

readme.text: 新动画 = 一个引擎文件 + `registry.ts` 里一行注册；参数经 `paramsSchema` 声明后设置页自动渲染，播放链路零改动（ADR-003）。

[中文](README.md)

An opening-animation plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web: every time a dsh web page loads, a fullscreen overlay plays the opening content you picked — an image animation or a video — then a configurable transition hands the screen back to the UI. Structurally identical to [dsh-custom-skin](https://github.com/SLin-code/dsh-custom-skin) and can run alongside it.

- **Image openings** (jpg/png/webp/gif/avif, ≤20 MB, decode-probed at import and rejected past 32 megapixels (≈ an 8K frame), library cap of 8 items; capacity cut-offs and decode failures are reported, never dropped silently)
- **Image opening playback order** (single / sequence / shuffle, single by default): decides which image opening plays at each startup — sequence starts from the selected animation, then advances through the image list on each startup, wrapping around; shuffle never repeats the previous one when there is more than one; the preview always plays the selected media, and videos ignore this setting
- **Video openings** (mp4/webm/mkv, ≤256 MB, decode support probed at import): audible-first autoplay (the engine always attempts to unmute on the first playing event: it plays audible at the configured volume when the browser allows audible autoplay — a user gesture, a high Media Engagement Index, or an allow-listed site — and falls back to muted playback automatically when the browser rejects audible autoplay, so the picture never freezes; a Click-for-sound pill appears on the opening, and clicking it unmutes without skipping), the transition runs when the video ends —

Requires Node ^22.19.0 or ≥24:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm check   # typecheck + vitest + build
```

CI ([.github/workflows/ci.yml](.github/workflows/ci.yml)) runs `pnpm check` plus a packaging check on a Node 22.19 / 24 matrix. The test suite is jsdom-level unit/behavior testing (controller, watchdogs, every animation engine, preference parsing); canvas rendering, media decoding and the real playback path need manual verification in a real browser — the "Preview opening" button on this plugin's settings page in a running dsh web instance is the recommended manual regression path.

readme.section: Install into a dsh web profile
readme.text:
```sh
cd $DSH_HOME/profiles/web
pnpm add <path to this directory or a tarball>

A new animation = one engine file + one registration line in `registry.ts`; parameters declared via `paramsSchema` are rendered by the settings page automatically, with zero changes to the playback path (ADR-003).
